purpose: Determine whether COMP-012 checkpoint predictions follow semantic legal actions under exact cyclic menu renumbering, before choosing permutation augmentation or broader state/deck coverage.

transformation.definition: For menu size n and rotation r in [1,n-1]: original_to_assigned[i]=(i+r) mod n; assigned_to_original[j]=(j-r) mod n; new_menu[j]=old_menu[assigned_to_original[j]].

required_metrics: rotated semantic top1 and top-set invariance
micro and source-row macro teacher agreement/probability/NLL
accuracy by assigned and original target position, rotation, menu size, and window
evaluation.health_gate: both checkpoints account for 57 source rows, 221 nonzero rotations, and 1134 candidate sequence scores; all input/reference/checkpoint/source hashes remain unchanged; no partial output

diagnostic_rules_fixed_before_scoring.action_order_sensitivity_primary: either checkpoint has rotated semantic_top1_invariance < 0.75 or mean_semantic_probability_total_variation > 0.20
diagnostic_rules_fixed_before_scoring.strong_cyclic_stability: both checkpoints have rotated semantic_top1_invariance >= 0.90 and mean_semantic_probability_total_variation <= 0.10
diagnostic_rules_fixed_before_scoring.mixed_or_borderline: neither primary rule nor strong-stability rule holds
diagnostic_rules_fixed_before_scoring.next_if_sensitive: run one permutation-augmented static-SFT intervention while holding teacher states, model, mixed mask, and optimizer family fixed
diagnostic_rules_fixed_before_scoring.next_if_stable: prioritize expanded train-window conditional coverage or DAgger before model scaling
diagnostic_rules_fixed_before_scoring.next_if_mixed: run a tiny permutation-augmented positive control before choosing between augmentation and coverage

verification_before_model_load.actual_dataset_parse: 57 rows, 221 rotations, 1134 candidate sequences per checkpoint

compute: local Apple Silicon/Metal only; no RunPod
